<!--
Description: feed author email
Expect:      not bozo and feed['author_detail']['email'] == 'me@example.com'
-->
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <author>
    <name>Example author</name>
    <email>me@example.com</email>
    <uri>http://example.com/</uri>
  </author>
</feed>

<!--
Description: item author maps to author_detail email if both name and email are given
Expect:      not bozo and entries[0]['author_detail']['email'] == 'me@example.com'
-->
<rss version="2.0">
<channel>
<item>
<author>Example editor (me@example.com)</author>
</item>
</channel>
</rss>

<!--
Description: channel author maps to author_detail email if both name and email are given (email contains +)
Expect:      not bozo and feed['author_detail']['email'] == 'me+spam@example.com'
-->
<rss version="2.0">
<channel>
<author>Example editor (me+spam@example.com)</author>
</channel>
</rss>

<!--
Description: entry author email
Expect:      not bozo and entries[0]['author_detail']['email'] == 'me@example.com'
-->
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
<entry>
  <author>
    <name>Example author</name>
    <email>me@example.com</email>
    <uri>http://example.com/</uri>
  </author>
</entry>
</feed>

<!--
Description: item author maps to author_detail email if both name and email are given
Expect:      not bozo and entries[0]['author_detail']['email'] == 'me@example.com'
-->

</item>
</channel>
</rss>

name: "🧪 Test"

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"
      - "releases"

jobs:
  test:
    name: "${{ matrix.name }}"
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: "Linux"
            runner: "ubuntu-latest"
            cpythons:
              - "3.10"
              - "3.11"
              - "3.12"
              - "3.13"
              - "3.14"
            cpython-beta: "3.15"
            cache-paths:
              - ".mypy_cache/"
            cache-key-hash-files:
              - "docs/conf.py"
              - "pyproject.toml"
              - "requirements/*/requirements.txt"
            tox-skip-environments:
              - "coverage-html"

            # macOS and Windows tests target only the upper and lower CPython versions.
          - name: "macOS"
            runner: "macos-latest"
            cpythons:
              - "3.10"
              - "3.14"
            tox-factors:
              - "chardet"
            cache-key-hash-files:
              - "pyproject.toml"
              - "requirements/*/requirements.txt"

          - name: "Windows"
            runner: "windows-latest"
            cpythons:
              - "3.10"
              - "3.14"
            tox-factors:
              - "chardet"
            cache-key-hash-files:
              - "pyproject.toml"
              - "requirements/*/requirements.txt"

    uses: "kurtmckee/github-workflows/.github/workflows/tox.yaml@19c3c069be51d3bfc3ac73e85e81b2b1646e91a8" # v1.7
    with:
      config: "${{ toJSON(matrix) }}"

[tool.poetry]

[project]

]

    "coverage[toml]",

]

]
